name: showmd
title: ShowMD
description: Open your markdown files as readable pages in your browser. Edit them right there, and everything stays on your computer.
author: l0kyurue1

preferences.name: showmdPath
preferences.title: ShowMD Path
preferences.description: Path to the showmd binary. Leave empty to auto-detect it on PATH.

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Preferred port to check first for ShowMD. ShowMD running on other ports is also found.

preferences.name: reuseServer
preferences.title: Open in Running ShowMD
preferences.description: Open files in the ShowMD that's already running instead of starting another.
preferences.label: Open in running ShowMD

commands.name: open
commands.title: Open
commands.description: Open a recently viewed markdown file, or browse for a folder or file, in ShowMD

commands.name: manage-server
commands.title: Manage ShowMD
commands.description: View ShowMD's status, start, restart, or stop it

commands.name: browse-skills
commands.title: Browse Agent Skills
commands.description: Browse your installed agent skills in ShowMD

commands.name: open-selected
commands.title: Open Selected
commands.description: Open the markdown file or folder selected in Finder or Explorer

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.description: Show ShowMD's status in the menu bar, with recents and quick controls (macOS only)

tools.name: open-document
tools.title: Open Document
tools.description: Open a markdown file or folder by path in ShowMD.

tools.name: list-recents
tools.title: List Recents
tools.description: List the markdown files and folders recently viewed in ShowMD.

tools.name: server-status
tools.title: ShowMD Status
tools.description: Report whether ShowMD is running, summarize the primary ShowMD, and count how many are running.
